Terms

Last updated September 25, 2026

By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

About this site

This website is published by the office of T. L. Harris, the District 6 commissioner on the Memphis-Shelby County Schools Board of Education, to share information with residents. Official Memphis-Shelby County Schools information, including Board policies, agendas, meeting records, school information and district data, is published by MSCS at scsk12.org and on BoardDocs. Where this site and an official MSCS source differ, the official source controls.

For information only

What is on this site is general information. It is not legal, financial or professional advice, and it is not an official act of the Board. A commissioner is one vote of nine, and statements on this site are not decisions of the Board.

Accuracy

This office works to keep the site accurate and current, and names its sources where it can. Meeting dates, times and places can change, so please confirm them with the official MSCS calendar before you go. Content may be corrected or updated at any time.

Using the site

Please use the site lawfully. Do not try to break into it, disrupt it, or use it to send spam or to harass anyone.

Content and ownership

Text, photographs and design on this site belong to T. L. Harris or are used with permission, unless noted. You are welcome to link to any page and to quote short passages with credit. Please do not copy large parts of the site, and do not use his name, image or the site’s design in a way that suggests he has endorsed you or your product without written permission. News coverage, broadcast video and other third-party material remain the property of their owners.

Links to other sites

Links to other websites are provided for your convenience. This office does not control those sites and is not responsible for what they say or do.

No warranty

The site is provided “as is,” without promises that it will always be available, error-free or complete. To the fullest extent the law allows, the office is not responsible for losses that come from using the site or relying on what it says.

Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated. The date at the top shows when they last changed, and continued use of the site means you accept the current version.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee.

Contact

Questions about these terms can go to the MSCS Board Office at (901) 416-5447 or boardoffice@scsk12.org, or through the Contact page.
